_meta.what: Truncated VSOP87D: heliocentric L (rad), B (rad), R (au) of eight planets, ecliptic and equinox of date. series[variable][power] = [[A, B, C], …]; value = Σ_p t^p · Σ A·cos(B + C·t), t = Julian millennia (TT) from J2000.0.
_meta.theory: P. Bretagnon & G. Francou, “Planetary theories in rectangular and spherical variables. VSOP87 solutions”, Astron. Astrophys. 202, 309 (1988)
_meta.source: https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/VI/81/ (CDS catalogue VI/81; mirror of IMCCE)
_meta.note: The Moon, the lunar node and Pluto are not in VSOP87; bnamesday-sky.js carries them and says where each comes from.
